headline: Solar Electrical Installer
summary: Former electronics production operator now installing rooftop solar systems in Leyte. Four years on an assembly line taught me careful work, testing and quality checks; I trained in electrical installation and solar PV and have installed residential and commercial systems for the past year. I follow safety rules at height strictly.

certifications.name: Electrical Installation and Maintenance NC II

skills: Installing solar panels, inverters and electrical equipment

experience.title: Solar Electrical Installer
bullets: Install rooftop solar panels, inverters and batteries on homes and small businesses.
Wire DC and AC circuits and test each system before hand-over.
Use harnesses and roof anchors on every job and inspect equipment before use.

experience.title: Production Operator (Electronics)
bullets: Assembled and soldered circuit boards on a surface-mount line.
Operated reflow and testing machines and cleared minor jams.
Inspected boards for defects and logged results in the quality system.

education.credential: Senior High School, TVL Track – Electronics
